label.explanation: The identity provider (idp.example) started responding slowly (lines 182, 183, 185) and then hanging until auth-svc's 30s timeout, which made account-svc's calls to auth-svc time out too (lines 190, 191, 204, 205, 209, 210). Pool saturation in account-svc (lines 215, 219, 224, 232, 243) is resource_exhaustion but secondary, and the edge-proxy 503s (lines 211, 217, 222, 225, 228, 236, 239, 241, 245, 251, 254, 256) are the paging symptom. external_outage is defensible since the third party is degraded, but the observable failure is hanging calls, so dependency_timeout is the best label. Red herrings: line 181 (a single API client being rate-limited, which is the limiter working as intended); line 164 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits); line 48 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full).
